name: Half-Orc
description: Half-orcs' grayish pigmentation, sloping foreheads, jutting jaws, prominent teeth, and towering builds make their orcish heritage plain for all to see. Half-orcs are strong and hardy, and their orcish blood also gives them stamina matched by few other peoples.

grants.name: Darkvision (60 ft)
grants.description: See in dim light within 60 ft. as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (no color, only shades of gray).

grants.name: Relentless Endurance
grants.description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Usable once per long rest.

grants.name: Savage Attacks
grants.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.
